# ufoo 4.0.10

Group members can now select role-specific models across Codex, Claude and agy.
Explicit `type: "ucode"` members use their effective native provider, honor manual
model overrides, and retain provider, model and reasoning effort on recovery.

The 4.0.6–4.0.9 tags were superseded before npm publication. This release
contains the complete code and documentation updates since 4.0.5.
This release includes the complete async agy credential integration and portable
browser test fixtures.

## Changes

- Run general macOS CI and Intel builds on macOS 15 Intel runners to avoid
  hosted ARM queue exhaustion. Run the native ARM build and Rust tests on
  macOS 26 after the macOS 15 ARM pool repeatedly failed to allocate a runner.
- Allow explicit reuse of a prior native ARM artifact only after checking the
  ancestor commit, identical Rust sources/lockfile and successful native build,
  tests and smoke check. All current JavaScript release gates still run.
- Wait for observed background-command output in regression tests instead of
  assuming Node starts within 250 ms; clean up processes even if assertions fail.

- Move maintained references into `docs/`, archive implemented designs, update
  contributor instructions and package the observability guide from its new path.

- Keep Node.js 18.17 support for core features; the optional browser feature
  requires Node.js 20+ and now reports that requirement before launching.
- Default agy main-agent calls to Carbon and auxiliary calls to Hydrogen.

- Configure all seven built-in groups with provider-specific role defaults and
  manual overrides. agy uses Carbon for architecture and diagnosis, Argon for
  coordination and review, and Hydrogen for implementation and verification.
- Add native agy API transport, credential inspection and model discovery.
- Add optional ufoo Browser installation, Chrome Native Messaging and a shared
  Playwright relay with tab ownership. Refresh the extension popup and icons.
- Improve shared runtime context retention, tool failure limits, task deadlines,
  transport retries and background command/condition wakeups.
- Restore external agent messaging without embedding externally owned sessions
  in the ufoo dashboard. Improve internal agent focus, cancellation and panes.
- Fix browser relay test context ordering and verify evaluation results. Keep
  native API credential checks separate from external CLI login status.

## Validation

- Full JavaScript suite: 2995 passed on Node 18.17 and the local modern Node; the opt-in real Chrome integration test
  also passed separately (authenticated tabs, form actions, screenshots and
  disconnect without closing Chrome).
- Rust renderer: 80 passed; native release binary rebuilt.
- Package contents and production dependency release checks passed.
- Secret scan of the current source tree and 419 historical commits found no
  actual credentials; five matches were reviewed public identifiers or test fixtures.

Upgrade with `npm install -g u-foo@4.0.10`. Newly started processes load the new
version. Restart an existing daemon when ready to apply runtime changes to it;
existing workers are not automatically restarted by installation.
